output.summary:
Supplier overlap across Woking, Guildford, Waverley.
Windows: Guildford Apr - Sep 2026 (FY2026/27 Q1-Q2) - quarterly (financial-year quarters), by payment date: 6883 rows, GBP 48,624,788, 2026-04-02 to 2026-09-29; Waverley Apr - Sep 2026 (FY2026/27 periods 1-6) - half-yearly, by accounting period (payment date not published): 3246 rows, GBP 28,275,155, periods 2026-01 to 2026-06; Woking Nov 2025 - Apr 2026 - monthly, by payment (clearance) date: 9718 rows, GBP 64,974,729, 2025-11-03 to 2026-04-30.
228 supplier pairs are shared with confidence; 0 of them are resolved from remembered human decisions. 217 candidate pairs still need a human to confirm or split, and 0 pairs are recorded as different organisations.
Combined published spend across the shared pairs is GBP 34,786,202.
Largest shared suppliers: Surrey County Council / Surrey County Council (GBP 4,435,329, auto); SURREY COUNTY COUNCIL / Surrey County Council (GBP 3,159,348, auto); WAVERLEY BOROUGH COUNCIL / Waverley Borough Council (GBP 3,157,363, auto); SMITH AND BYFORD LIMITED / Smith & Byford Limited (GBP 2,061,817, auto); PiLON Limited / Pilon Limited (GBP 1,362,420, auto).
Numbers come from the councils' own published payment files; each row carries a provenance id.
recommendations: Confirm or split the 3 largest unconfirmed pairs: 'VAIL WILLIAMS LLP' (Woking) vs 'Ian Williams Limited' (Waverley) - combined GBP 3,537,527, similarity 0.8; 'Vail Williams Llp' (Guildford) vs 'Ian Williams Limited' (Waverley) - combined GBP 3,496,578, similarity 0.8; 'MILESTONE SOUTH EAST LIMITED' (Woking) vs 'Milestone West Limited' (Guildford) - combined GBP 1,730,206, similarity 0.7647

Start supplier consolidation with the largest shared commercial suppliers (public bodies excluded): SMITH AND BYFORD LIMITED (GBP 2,061,817); PiLON Limited (GBP 1,362,420); Zurich Insurance Plc (GBP 1,197,787); SAVILLS (UK) LTD (GBP 1,139,236); GRANT THORNTON UK LLP (GBP 735,104)
To record a decision: POST /run with input.query = "Confirm that '<name A>' (<council>) is the same supplier as '<name B>' (<council>)" - the Memory agent will apply it to every later answer.

agents.name: Router
agents.role: Classifies a free-text request into a supported flow, extracts councils and parameters, or returns a structured unsupported error

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Runs federated SQL against the data layer (Zetaris live, cached council files in sample mode) and returns rows with provenance

agents.name: Resolver
agents.role: Normalises supplier names, scores cross-council matches, applies remembered decisions and Companies House identity; marks what still needs a human

agents.name: Memory
agents.role: Meterless H-MEM: recalls earlier human decisions (supplier matches, approvals) and stores new ones with provenance

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: Validates provenance and thresholds on every result; rejects and returns work that does not clear the bar (one real bounce when needed)

agents.name: Writer
agents.role: Drafts briefings and letters from the evidence table (NVIDIA Nemotron via Meterless Nightshift; deterministic template in sample mode)
